formula: (reference used-car acquisition cost - expected residual/salvage) / expected remaining usable years

acquisition.needed: official or reproducible used-car price for the frozen modest gasoline compact/midsize 8-12 year cohort
candidates: BLS CPI used cars and trucks (index only)

residual.needed: expected residual/salvage at end of remaining usable years
candidates: no official national salvage schedule for this cohort

usable_years.needed: remaining usable years for the frozen cohort
candidates: NHTS vehicle age distributions are usage, not remaining-life tables

recommendation: Do not invent $10,000 / $2,000 / 5 years. Leave FORMULA_FROZEN_INPUTS_PENDING.
